description: 5 should-trigger + 4 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers naming the voice when surfaces diverge, a tone matrix per audience cell, a senior persona asking for a defensible artefact, writing the brand-voice slot, and a German phrasing. Should-not covers the three the skill excludes (copy-editing one asset, the message stack, channel tactics) plus one unrelated counterexample.

queries.q: define our voice — the same segment hears three different brands from us per quarter
build the tone matrix: error copy, onboarding and sales follow-up all read differently
our CMO wants a voice artefact a writer on deadline can actually defend against
write the brand-voice slot — three attributes, the terms we never use, and the claims we can back
leg fest, wie wir klingen, und was wir nie sagen
tighten this one landing page paragraph, it reads flabby
queries.note: copy-editing a single asset is a writer's job, not voice definition

queries.q: what is our primary message and which three support it
which subject line should the nurture email use
queries.note: channel-specific tactics are out of scope for a channel-agnostic skill

queries.q: add a composite index on orders(customer_id, created_at)
